title: 2 Dumb Shoplifters Caught Red-Handed
description:
On April 11th, 2024. 2 dumb shoplifters thought they could get away after stealing from multiple stores until detectives and sheriffs busted up their plan. During the arrest, they found that one of the shoplifters brought their baby with them to the shoplift and also found a sh*t ton of cocaine in the car as well.
